description: This file defines the Session controller for the Coocook web application, handling user login, logout, and session management functionalities.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Session
classes.description: Controller class managing user session actions such as login and logout within the Coocook application.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests for user login, checking if user is already logged in and preparing login page data.

methods.name: post_login
methods.description: Processes POST request for user login, authenticates user credentials, manages session and cookies, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Handles user logout, clears session data, and redirects to a logged-out confirmation.
